name: oh-my-android
description: Let your AI agent see and drive the Android Emulator and phones: screenshots, UI tree in dp, tap, dark mode, RTL, logcat.
long_description: The MCP server of [Oh My Android](https://github.com/ateymoori/oh-my-android). Your agent can screenshot the screen (1 px = 1 dp), read a compact UI tree, tap and type, switch dark mode, font scale, locale / RTL and TalkBack, read logcat, SharedPreferences and SQLite, and run accessibility audits. Needs adb (Android Studio or the Android command-line tools) and macOS 26 or later. Install the Oh My Android app to choose the access level (Off, Read only, Full control); without it the server gives full control.

tools.name: list_devices
tools.description: Connected emulators and phones, and the emulators that can be started.

tools.name: get_device_state
tools.description: Device facts, app on screen, and current test settings.

tools.name: set_device_settings
tools.description: Dark mode, font scale, display size, locale / RTL, TalkBack, network, GPS, battery.

tools.name: get_ui
tools.description: Compact UI tree with refs, positions in dp.

tools.name: accessibility_audit
tools.description: TalkBack order, missing labels, small touch targets.

tools.name: tap
tools.description: Tap by ref, visible text, or x,y in dp.

tools.name: swipe
tools.description: Swipe or scroll in a direction.

tools.name: open_app
tools.description: Launch an app or open a deep link; reports start time.

tools.name: install_apk

tools.name: logcat

tools.name: emulator_action
